stem: The reader can conclude that when Hillerich first asked his father to make wood bats, Hillerich's father —

options.label: A
options.text: planned to change his business by making only wood bats

options.label: B
options.text: believed metal bats would sell better than wood bats

options.label: C
options.text: wanted to sell his company rather than make wood bats

options.label: D
options.text: thought his company would not benefit from making wood bats
